messages:
maria_p: :wave: Hey team — finalizing the annual planning weekend agenda. We locked dates: May 14-15 (Fri/Sat) at Pier 9. Need owners for: main deck (company vision + metrics), product roadmap walkthrough, engineering tech deep dive, breakout facilitation rota, AV/runbook, travel & accommodations. Please reply with which you can own by EOD Wednesday.

jonas: I can own product roadmap walkthrough. Will prep 20-min + 10-min Q&A. Adding a draft in Notion: https://notion.so/xxxx

sophia: I'll take breakout facilitation rota. Can do a short facilitator playbook for rotations and timing.

alex: I'll handle AV/runbook and set up a checklist for connectors, mics, and streaming. Need someone to validate the network—@kevin?

kevin: happy to validate network on-site. Also volunteer to pair with alex for test run.

maria_p: thanks! @jonas please link the Notion page. For main deck owner — we still need someone. Anyone comfortable synthesizing exec & product? Could split into "exec narrative" and "metrics deep-dive".

kevin: I can co-own metrics deep-dive with marcom, but not exec narrative.

sophia: @maria_p I can help with exec narrative outline (high-level only).

alex: quick note: AV runbook will include this snippet for streaming command:
```
ffmpeg -re -i /dev/video0 -c:v libx264 -b:v 2M -f flv rtmp://streaming.internal/plan
```
Please don't change default ports.

maria_p: excellent. Also need dietary restrictions and travel confirmations. I'll ping calendar-bot to update RSVPs.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Annual Planning Weekend" May 14 09:00 - May 15 16:00. RSVPs: 42 invited.

jonas: I'll add slide outlines by Tuesday. Can we aim for a 60-minute product strategy block? want to leave time for customer breakout.

sophia: yes 60 is fine. Also proposing 3 canned prompts for breakout prompts, will share.

maria_p: final ask — owners, add a 1-paragraph launch criteria for any new initiative you plan to propose (success metrics + roll-back). We'll use that to pre-filter backlog. Thanks all :thumbsup:.
